integrity: The six-class co-maximal structure is taken from the published Boolean blow-up theorem and independently reconstructed for prime-power chain-ring products in the verifier. The forcing proof establishes both necessity and sufficiency of omitting at most one vertex per class, including the two-field boundary. The rank witness is the actual adjacency blow-up of an invertible six-vertex quotient matrix. Parameter recovery uses the six negative roots and an exact product identity.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes exactly three local factors.
The product of three fields is excluded; its unblown Boolean graph has a different forcing polynomial.
The polynomial recovers the numbers of proper ideals in the local factors, not their ring isomorphism types.
The stronger nilpotency-length recovery conclusion applies to finite chain rings.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.

General modular compression already covers the type-profile mechanism; originality is restricted to the exact co-maximal specialization, parameter recovery, graph recognizability, and rank conclusion.
title: Zero forcing polynomials recognize nonreduced three-factor co-maximal ideal graphs
